.TH "NPM-DIFF" "1" "March 2026" "NPM@10.9.7" ""
.SH "NAME"
\fBnpm-diff\fR - The registry diff command
.SS "Synopsis"
.P
.RS 2
.nf
npm diff \[lB]...<paths>\[rB]
.fi
.RE
.SS "Description"
.P
Similar to its \fBgit diff\fR counterpart, this command will print diff patches of files for packages published to the npm registry.
.RS 0
.IP \(bu 4
\fBnpm diff --diff=<spec-a> --diff=<spec-b>\fR
.P
Compares two package versions using their registry specifiers, e.g: \fBnpm diff --diff=pkg@1.0.0 --diff=pkg@^2.
